scope: A sharpened hypothesis for finite-budget virtual-state planning, contingent on competent Clean. Not a confirmed security mechanism or novelty score.
claim_to_test: Two models can agree on every admissible complete action rollout yet produce different finite-budget lifted-planner decisions through off-support intermediate queries.

prior_art.known: GRASP discusses adversarial sensitivity when optimizing virtual states and blocks state-input gradients.
Data-support prediction error can be exactly zero while off-support error is unrestricted. That alone is not a new mathematical principle.
prior_art.boundary: Inspected formulation ranks action-induced rollouts; not a demonstration of two models with identical full-rollout maps but distinct lifted-optimizer execution.

prior_art.known: Action-only gradient planning can exploit prediction errors; online and adversarial world-model training address this train-test gap.
prior_art.boundary: Training modifications do not preserve the complete rollout map.

prior_art.known: Checkpoint backdoors in world models can manipulate downstream control; model supply-chain attacks alone are not a new framing.

bounded_search_limit: These inspected papers do not establish absence of all relevant prior art. No numerical novelty assessment is scientific evidence.

candidate_permission.restriction: Fixed bounded direction v and smooth state-only gate h; no action, goal, iteration or optimizer-state access. h and its first derivative vanish on the declared protected domain. Direction, amplitude and tube width must be fixed before observing intervention utility.
candidate_permission.reason: Avoid assigning arbitrary action Jacobians or retargeting the solver objective. Actual interface exposure remains unestablished; this is researcher-defined model replacement.

premises: Identical encoded initial state and goal; protected root model value and action derivatives equal
Identical global random draws, independent-coordinate Adam, no extra cross-time gradient coupling
Published GRASP state-input detach and its existing visual loss
conditional_prediction.before_first_sync: The first action block a0 and first virtual state s1 remain identical. Their updates form a closed subsystem: a0 depends on s0,s1,g and s1 depends on F(s0,a0)-s1; suffix interventions cannot enter through detached later state inputs.
conditional_prediction.after_first_sync: A suffix action difference may reach a0 through the full-rollout action-gradient sync, even though both models implement the same rollout function. Sync starts at different action sequences and takes finite steps.
conditional_prediction.state_reset_fact: The adapter replaces actions and resets Adam after sync but retains the virtual state variables.
conditional_prediction.execution_boundary: Native num_act_stepped=3 also directly executes suffix blocks. First-action mediation alone does not account for every executed difference.
conditional_prediction.early_divergence_rule: First-action divergence before first sync contradicts this conditional prediction; investigate implementation, protected values/gradients, RNG or assumptions rather than count it as a success.

necessary_controls: Paired full-rollout sync from identical action inputs must return the same values, action gradients and updated actions.
No-sync pair should preserve the first action block; this is a mechanism negative control, not an established capable defense.
Clean/modified-model crossed with query projection, preserving Clean utility and equal cost, would be needed for a projection defense claim.
fundamental_limit: Exact dynamics-feasible trajectories starting inside an invariant set remain inside it. Identical complete rollout maps give identical action objectives; this candidate concerns the finite-budget solver trajectory, not new exact feasible plans.
strongest_objection: Off-support freedom plus known virtual-state sensitivity may be an obvious numerical optimization counterexample. Arbitrary large goal-tailored model replacement or a weak custom planner would add little scientific value.
current_runtime_evidence: Only the earlier finite-sample affine qualification has run. No GRASP Clean, dynamics extension, sync mediation or actual harm is established by this report.
next_test: Bounded Clean run using the published GRASP class and README settings with the existing MetaWorld task; classify composed configuration explicitly and measure runtime before expensive expansion.
